implementation:
let rec go (rest suffix : List Nat) : List Nat :=
  match rest with
  | [] => suffix
  | x :: tail => x :: go tail suffix
go xs ys
proof:
by
  unfold Spec
  intro xs ys
  have invariant : ∀ rest suffix : List Nat,
      candidate.go rest suffix = rest ++ suffix := by
    intro rest
    induction rest with
    | nil => intro suffix; rfl
    | cons x rest ih =>
      intro suffix
      simpa [candidate.go] using congrArg (List.cons x) (ih suffix)
  simpa [candidate] using invariant xs ys
